description: Queensland coal statistics and industry review tables is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by Natural Resources, Mines and Energy; Transport and Main Roads, Qld. Members: Annual coal statistics, QLD; Coal industry review statistical tables, QLD. Example entry: Annual statistical coal mining data produced for the Queensland mining industry. Spreadsheets of raw coal and saleable coal production by region, overburden, Queensland distribution, interstate distribution, exports by port, exports by region and exports by country, and stockpile balances. Blackwater; Goonyella Riverside; Peak Downs; Clermont Coal; Rolleston; Saraji; Hail Creek; German Creek; Lake Vermont; Curragh. Coverage is Queensland, 2012 to 2017; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-12-18. Files and pages listed: HTML (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
